news.summary: Palantir shares have fallen more than 20% from their October high in a month of AI and tech sell-offs, even though third-quarter revenue rose 96% and the company reported its best quarter ever. Director Peter Thiel disclosed a $122 million share purchase made under a trading plan, and the stock has risen about 14% since that purchase. Michael Burry said he kept put options on Palantir while exiting his Nasdaq-100 short.
